query:
UPDATE users
        SET password_hash = $1,
            encrypted_private_key = $2,
            private_key_nonce = $3,
            private_key_algorithm = $4,
            recovery_code_hash = $5,
            encrypted_private_key_recovery = $6,
            private_key_recovery_nonce = $7,
            private_key_recovery_algorithm = $8,
            updated_at = NOW()
        WHERE id = $9
